title: Walking in the Light
keyVerse: This is the message we have heard from him and declare to you: God is light; in him there is no darkness at all. — 1 John 1:5
message:
There is a kind of walking that God has called every believer to — a walk in the light. To walk in the light is to live transparently before God, holding nothing back, hiding nothing in the shadows.

John tells us plainly: God is light, and in Him there is no darkness at all. When we come into fellowship with Him, His light exposes what is hidden and heals what is broken. We do not walk in the light to become worthy; we walk in the light because we have been made His children.

Today, let the light of God search your heart. Where there is darkness, invite Him in. Where there is fear, let His truth speak. As you walk in the light, you will find that fellowship with God — and with one another — becomes sweet, and the blood of Jesus keeps you clean.
prayerPoints: Father, let Your light expose and heal every hidden thing in me.
Lord, help me to walk transparently before You today.
I receive fresh fellowship with You and with Your people, in Jesus' name.

title: The God Who Renews
keyVerse: But those who hope in the LORD will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles. — Isaiah 40:31
message:
Weariness is not the end of your story. The same God who set the stars in place does not grow tired, and He gives strength to the weary.

The secret is in the waiting — not passive idleness, but active hope that keeps its eyes on the Lord. Those who wait on Him exchange their fading strength for His inexhaustible power.

Whatever has drained you this season, bring it to the One who never faints. He will renew you, and you will run without growing weary.
prayerPoints: Lord, I wait on You — renew my strength today.
Father, lift me above every weariness on eagles' wings.
I refuse to faint; Your power is at work in me.
